_comment: Batch 1 (2026-10-13). Same pipeline and review rules as Unbounded MN. Glyph references '@X' resolve through each font's cmap.
license_note: OFL.txt declares no Reserved Font Name, so the name may be reused; the edition is still renamed 'Bona Nova SC MN' so it never clashes with the original. Regular and Bold only: the Italic is not built (its v is a rounded cursive form with no straight arm edges). This family shows all lowercase as small caps by default (ccmp -> .sc), so the lowercase ө and ү are built directly as small-cap forms: ө = barred small-cap o (uni043E.sc + bar from uni043D.sc), ү = composite of the Latin small-cap y.sc; kerning and anchors come from the matching small-cap glyphs. Capital Ө and Ү are the normal capitals.
italic_note: The Italic is not included: its v is a rounded cursive form with a single bottom point and no straight arm edges, so the pipeline's straight-stem ү (v + the font's own р stem) cannot be built from it without redesigning the letter.
sc_note: Bona Nova SC shows ALL lowercase (Latin, Cyrillic, digits) as small caps by default (ccmp -> .sc glyphs). The lowercase letters ө and ү are therefore built directly as small-cap forms: ө = barred small-cap o (uni043E.sc + bar measured from uni043D.sc), ү = composite of the Latin small-cap y.sc; kerning and mark anchors come from the matching small-cap glyphs. Capital Ө and Ү are unchanged.
